address_zh: 新疆维吾尔自治区喀什地区泽普县
address_en: Zepu County, Kashgar Prefecture, Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region
intro_zh: 喀什地区泽普金湖杨景区占地面积有4万亩，其中天然胡杨林面积达2万亩。景区以广袤的天然胡杨林与开阔的叶尔羌河及河两岸平坦、荒芜的戈壁滩形成独特的自然风貌。胡杨、水、绿洲、戈壁四位一体的自然风貌向人们展示了一幅边塞画卷，堪称塔里木盆地西边缘不可多得的一处旅游胜地。
intro_en: Zepu Jinhu Yang Scenic Area in Kashgar region covers an area of ​​40,000 acres, of which the natural Populus euphratica forest area reaches 20,000 acres. The scenic area has a unique natural style with its vast natural Populus euphratica forest, the open Yarkand River and the flat, deserted Gobi Desert on both sides of the river. The four-in-one natural landscape of Populus euphratica, water, oasis and Gobi presents a picture of a frontier fortress, which can be called a rare tourist attraction on the western edge of the Tarim Basin.

foreign_visitors.note_zh: 中国 5A 景区通常对境外游客开放；部分景区需护照实名预约，出行前请以官网为准。
foreign_visitors.note_en: Most 5A sites admit international visitors; passport-based reservations may be required. Check the official site before travelling.
